_comment: Material database for phase-field fracture simulations. Each entry lists the problem type it is valid for plus the properties required for that type. A single material can appear under several aliases if it is used across problem types (e.g. linear-elastic and dynamic with the same elastic moduli but the latter needs rho).

Steel_bench_2D_PE.description: Three-point bending benchmark (2D plane strain), from bench_amr.py

Ceramic_surfing_2D_PE.description: Surfing boundary value problem (2D plane strain), from surfing_amr_sota.py

Glass_dyn_2D_PS.description: Dynamic branching crack (2D plane stress), from dyn_branch_amr.py

Al_ductile_2D_PE.description: Aluminium alloy dogbone (2D plane strain J2 plasticity), from ductile_amr.py
Al_ductile_2D_PE.p_critical_comment: sigma_ts in the ductile code is 2*sigma_y0; pcr = sigma_y0/H_hardening.

Al_ductile_3D.description: Aluminium alloy dogbone (3D J2 plasticity, extrusion of the 2D case)

Rubber_LopezPamies_2D_PS.description: Slant pokerchip, Lopez-Pamies Ogden (2D plane stress), from slant_amr.py

Rubber_LopezPamies_2D_PE.description: Lopez-Pamies Ogden rubber (2D plane strain variant)
